data.name: Cement Concrete Wearing Coat M-30 Grade
data.rate_src: TG COMMON SOR 2025-26 and MORTH standard data book 2019
data.description: Providing and laying cement concrete wearing coat of M-30 grade including reinforcement complete as per drawing and Technical Specifications (Ref. MoRTH Spec. 2702). Comprises M30 grade concrete (as per Item 14.1(C), excluding formwork), HYSD bar reinforcement @ 0.075 MT/cum (as per Item 14.2, excluding overheads & profit), labour for cleaning deck slab concrete surface, overhead charges @ 20% and contractor's profit @ 10%. Output taken as 1 cum. Applied directly over the Deck Slab.

data.name: Mastic Asphalt wearing course on deck slab
data.rate_src: TG COMMON SOR 2025-26 and MORTH standard data book 2019
data.description: Providing and laying 12 mm thick mastic asphalt wearing course on top of deck slab excluding prime coat with paving grade bitumen meeting the requirements given in table 500-29, prepared by using mastic cooker and laid to required level and slope after cleaning the surface, including providing antiskid surface with bitumen precoated fine grained hard stone chipping of 9.5 mm nominal size at the rate of 0.065 cum per 10 sqm and at an approximate spacing of 10 cm center to center in both directions, pressed when the temperature of surface not less than 100 deg. C, protruding 1 mm to 3 mm over mastic surface, all complete as per clause 515.

data.name: Precast RCC Railing (M30 Grade)
data.rate_src: TG COMMON SOR 2025-26 and MORTH standard data book 2019
data.description: Construction of precast RCC railing of M30 grade, aggregate size not exceeding 12 mm, true to line and grade, tolerance of vertical RCC post not to exceed 1 in 500, centre to centre spacing between vertical posts not to exceed 2000 mm, leaving adequate space between posts for expansion, complete as per approved drawings (MoRTH SD/202) and Technical Specifications (Ref. Clause 2703, 1500, 1600 & 1700). Includes M30 grade concrete for 28 vertical posts and 3-tier hand rails (total 4.092 cum for 48 m run), 5% additional formwork cost for casting-yard precasting, HYSD bar reinforcement @ 0.865 MT, 5% cost addition for handling and fixing of precast panels, overhead charges @ 20% and contractor's profit @ 10%. Output taken as 48 m (2 x 24 m span). Fixed on top of the Deck Slab edge.

data.name: Cast-in-situ RCC Railing (M30 Grade)
data.rate_src: TG COMMON SOR 2025-26 and MORTH standard data book 2019
data.description: Construction of RCC railing of M30 grade in-situ with 20 mm nominal size aggregate, true to line and grade, tolerance of vertical RCC post not to exceed 1 in 500, centre to centre spacing between vertical posts not to exceed 2000 mm, leaving adequate space between posts for expansion, complete as per approved drawings (MoRTH SD/202) and Technical Specifications (Ref. Clause 2703, 1500, 1600 & 1700). Includes M30 grade concrete for 28 vertical posts and 3-tier hand rails (total 4.092 cum for 48 m run), 12% additional formwork cost, HYSD bar reinforcement @ 0.865 MT, overhead charges @ 20% and contractor's profit @ 10%. data.rate_src: TG COMMON SOR 2025-26 and MORTH standard data book 2019

data.name: Compacting Original Ground - Case-I Compacting original ground supporting sub-grade
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Compacting Original Ground - Case-I Compacting original ground supporting sub-grade. Loosening of the ground upto a level of 500 mm below the sub-grade level, watering, graded and compacted in layers to meet requirement of table 300-2 for sub-grade construction.

data.name: Compacting Original Ground - Case-II Compacting original ground supporting embankment
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Compacting Original Ground - Case-II Compacting original ground supporting embankment. Loosening, leveling and Compacting original ground supporting embankment to facilitate placement of first layer of embankment, scarified to a depth of 150 mm, mixed with water at OMC and then compacted by rolling so as to achieve minimum dry density as given in Table 300-2 for embankment construction.

data.name: Stripping and Storing Top Soil
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Stripping, storing of top soil by road side at 15 m internal and re-application on embankment slopes, cut slopes and other areas in localities where the available embankment material is not conducive to plant growth.

data.name: Stripping, Storing and Re-laying Top Soil from Borrow Areas in Agriculture Fields.
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description:
Stripping, Storing and Re-laying Top Soil from Borrow Areas in Agriculture Fields.


Stripping of top soil from borrow areas located in agriculture fields, storing at a suitable place, spreading and re-laying after taking the borrow earth to maintain fertility of the agricultural field, finishing it to the required levels and satisfaction of the farmer.

data.name: Turfing with Sods
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description:
Turfing with Sods


Furnishing and laying of the live sods of perennial turf forming grass on embankment slope, verges or other locations shown on the drawing or as directed by the engineer including preparation of ground, fetching of sods and watering.

data.name: Seeding and Mulching
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description:
Seeding and Mulching


Preparation of seed bed on previously laid top soil, furnishing and placing of seeds, fertilizer, mulching material, applying bituminous emulsion at the rate of 0.23 litres per sqm and laying and fixing jute netting, including watering for 3 months all as per clause 308.

data.description:

data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description:
Sub-Surface Drains with Perforated Pipe


Construction of subsurface drain with perforated pipe of 100 mm internal diameter of metal/ asbestos cement/ cement concrete/PVC, closely jointed, perforations ranging from 3 mm to 6 mm depending upon size of material surrounding the pipe, with 150 mm bedding below the pipe and 300 mm cushion above the pipe, cross section of excavation 450 x 550 mm. Excavated material to be utilised in roadway at site.

data.name: Aggregate Sub-Surface Drains
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description:
Aggregate Sub-Surface Drains


Construction of aggregate sub surface drain 300 mm x 450 mm with aggregates conforming to table 300-4, excavated material to be utilised in roadway.

data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description:
Preparation and Surface Treatment of Formation.


Preparation and surface treatment of formation by removing mud and slurry, watering to the extent needed to maintain the desired moisture content, trimming to the required line, grade, profile and rolling with 8-10 tonne smooth wheeled roller, complete as per clause 310.

data.name: Construction of Rock fill Embankment
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description:
Construction of Rock fill Embankment


Construction of rock fill embankment with broken hard rock fragments of size not exceeding 300 mm laid in layers not exceeding 500 mm thick including filling of surface voids with stone spalls, blinding top layer with granular material, rolled with vibratory road roller, all complete as per clause 313.

Excavation in soil in hilly area by mechanical means including cutting and trimming of side slopes and disposing of excavated earth with all lifts and lead upto 1000 metres.

data.description: Prime Coat. Providing and applying primer coat with bitumen emulsion on prepared surface of granular Base including clearing of road surface and applying primer at the rate of 0.60 kg/sqm using mechanical means.

data.name: Tack Coat
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Tack Coat. Providing and applying tack coat with bitumen emulsion using emulsion pressure distributor at the rate of 0.20 kg per sqm on the prepared bituminous/granular surface cleaned with mechanical broom.

data.name: Bituminous Penetration Macadam - 50 mm thick
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Bituminous Penetration Macadam. Construction of penetration macadam over prepared coarse Base by providing a layer of compacted crushed coarse aggregate using chips spreader with alternate applications of bituminous binder and key aggregates and rolling with a smooth wheeled steel roller with 8-10 tonne capacity to achieve the desired degree of compaction. A 50 mm thick

data.name: Bituminous Penetration Macadam - 75 mm thick
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Bituminous Penetration Macadam. data.name: Built-up-Spray Grout
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Built-up-Spray Grout. Providing, laying and rolling of built-up-spray grout layer over prepared base consisting of a two layer composite construction of compacted crushed coarse aggregates using motor grader for aggregates, key stone chips spreader with application of bituminous binder after each layer, and with key aggregates placed on top of the second layer to serve as a Base conforming to the line, grades and cross-section specified, the compacted layer thickness being 75 mm

data.name: Surface Dressing - Case-1 :-19 mm nominal chipping size
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Surface Dressing. Providing and laying surface dressing as wearing course in single coat using crushed stone aggregates of specified size on a layer of bituminous binder laid on prepared surface and rolling with 8-10 tonne smooth wheeled steel roller - Case-1 :-19 mm nominal chipping size

data.name: Surface Dressing - Case-II 13 mm nominal size chipping
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Surface Dressing. Providing and laying surface dressing as wearing course in single coat using crushed stone aggregates of specified size on a layer of bituminous binder laid on prepared surface and rolling with 8-10 tonne smooth wheeled steel roller - Case-II 13 mm nominal size chipping

data.name: Open-Graded Premix Surfacing - (ii) Case-II: Open-Graded Premix Surfacing using cationic Bitumen Emulsion
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Open-Graded Premix Surfacing. Providing, laying and rolling of open-graded premix surfacing of 20 mm thickness composed of 13.2 mm to 5.6 mm aggregates either using penetration grade bitumen or cut-back or emulsion to required line, grade and level to serve as wearing course on a previously prepared base, including mixing in a suitable plant, laying and rolling with a smooth wheeled 8-10 tonne capacity, required level and grades. - (ii) Case-II: Open-Graded Premix Surfacing using cationic Bitumen Emulsion

data.name: Seal Coat - Case-I Type A
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Seal Coat. Providing and laying seal coat sealing the voids in a bituminous surface laid to the specified levels, grade and cross fall using Type A and B seal coats. (i) Case-I: Type A

data.name: Mastic Asphalt
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Mastic Asphalt — Providing and laying 25 mm thick mastic asphalt wearing course with paving grade bitumen meeting the requirements given in table 500-29, prepared by using mastic cooker and laid to required level and slope after cleaning the surface, including providing and spreading site with bitumen precoated fine grained hard stone chipping of 13.2 mm nominal size at the rate of 0.0050 cum per 10 sqm and at an approximate spacing of 10 cm centre to centre in both directions, pressed into surface when the temperature of surfaces is not less than 100°C, protruding 1 mm to 4 mm over mastic surface, all complete as per clause 515.

data.name: Slurry Seal – 1.5 mm thickness
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Slurry Seal — Providing and laying slurry seal consisting of a mixture of fine aggregates, portland cement filler, bituminous emulsion and water on a road surface including cleaning of surface, mixing of slurry seal in a suitable mobile plant, laying and compacting to provide even riding surface. (iii) 1.5 mm thickness

(ii) 3 mm thickness

data.name: Recycling of Bituminous Pavement with Central Recycling Plant
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Recycling of Bituminous Pavement with Central Recycling Plant — Recycling pavement by cold milling of existing bituminous layers, planing the surface after cold milling, reclaiming excavated material to the extent of 30 per cent of the required quantity, hauling and stock piling the reclaimed material near the central recycling plant after carrying out necessary checks and evaluation, adding fresh material including rejuvenators as required, mixing in a hot mix plant, transporting and laying at site and compacting to the required grade, level and thickness, all as specified in clause 517. i) Bitumen — A bitumen content is 4.5 per cent, bitumen weight of mix. For reclaimed material, fresh bitumen will be required to the extent of 60 per cent of normal requirement. ii) Aggregates — Percentage of mix requiring fresh aggregates - 70 per cent.

data.name: Fog Spray - Add for manual spreading of grit
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Fog Spray. In case it is decided by the engineer to bind the fog spray, the following may be added: Labour for manual spreading of grit.

data.name: Crack Prevention Course – Case-V: Bitumen impregnated geotextile
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Crack Prevention Course — (iv) Case-V: Bitumen impregnated geotextile — Providing and laying a bitumen impregnated geotextile layer after cleaning the road surface, geotextile conforming to requirements of clause 703.3, laid over a tack coat with 1.05 kg per sqm of paving grade bitumen 80-100 penetration and constructed to the requirement of clause 703.4.5.

data.name: Crack Prevention Course - Stress absorbing membrane (SAM) crack width above 9 mm and cracked area above 50 per cent
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Crack Prevention Course. (iii) Stress absorbing membrane (SAM) crack width above 9 mm and cracked area above 50 per cent. Providing and laying a single coat of a stress absorbing membrane over a cracked road surface, with crack width above 9 mm and cracked area above 50 per cent after cleaning with a mechanical broom, using modified binder complying with clause 521, sprayed at the rate of 15 kg per 10 sqm and spreading 11.2 mm crushed stone aggregates @ 0.12 cum per 10 sqm, sweeping the surface for uniform spread of aggregates and surface finished to conform to clause 902.

data.name: Crack Prevention Course - Case-IV: Bitumen impregnated geotextile
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Crack Prevention Course. (iv) Case - IV: Bitumen impregnated geotextile. Providing and laying a bitumen impregnated geotextile layer after cleaning the road surface with a tack coat with 1.05 kg per sqm of paving grade bitumen 80 - 100 penetration and constructed to the requirement of clause 703.4.5

data.name: Sub-Surface Drain with Geotextiles
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Sub-Surface Drain with Geotextiles — Construction of sub surface drain 200 mm dia using geotextiles treated with carbon black with physical properties as given in clause 702.2.3 formed into a stable network and a planar geocomposite structure, joints warped with geotextile to prevent ingress of soil, all as per clause 702 and approved drawings including excavation and backfilling.

data.name: Narrow Filter Sub-Surface Drain
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Narrow Filter Sub-Surface Drain — Construction of a narrow filter sub-surface drain consisting of porous or perforated pipe laid in narrow trench surrounded by a geotextile filter fabric, with a minimum of 450 mm overlap of fabric and installed as per clause 702.3 and 309.3.5 including excavation and backfilling.

data.name: Laying Paving Fabric Beneath a Pavement Overlay
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Laying Paving Fabric Beneath a Pavement Overlay — Providing and laying paving fabric with physical requirements as per table 704-2 over a tack coat of paving grade Bitumen 80-100 penetration, laid at the rate of 1 kg per sqm over thoroughly cleaned and repaired surface to provide a water resistant membrane and crack retarding layer. Paving fabric to be free of wrinkling and folding and to be laid before cooling of tack coat, brooming and rolling of surface with pneumatic roller to maximise paving fabric contact with pavement surface.

data.name: Laying Boulder Apron in Crates of Synthetic Geogrids
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Laying Boulder Apron in Crates of Synthetic Geogrids — Providing, preparing and laying of geogrid crated apron 1 m x 5 m, 600 mm thick including excavation and backfilling with baffles at 1 metre vertical, made with geogrids having characteristics as per clause 704.2, joining sides with connectors/ring staples, top corners to be tie tensioned, placing of suitable cross interval ties in layers of 300 mm connecting opposite side with lateral braces and tied with polymer braids to avoid bulging, constructed as per clause 704.3, filled with stone with minimum size of 200 mm and specific gravity not less than 2.65, packed with stone spalls, keyed to the foundation recess in case of sloping ground and laid over a layer of geotextile to prevent migration of fines, all as per clause 704 and laid as per clause 2503.3 and approved design.

data.name: Reinforced Earth Structures Assembling, joining and laying of reinforcing elements. With reinforcing elements of synthetic geogrids
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description:
Reinforced Earth Structures


Reinforced earth Structures have four main components as under:


a) Excavation for foundation, foundation concrete and cement concrete grooved seating in the foundation for facing elements (facia material).


b) Facia material and its placement.


c) Assembling, joining with facing elements and laying of the reinforcing elements.


d) Earth fill with granular material which is to be retained by the wall.


Each component is analysed separately as under:


considering Average height of wall = 8 m. Assembling, joining and laying of reinforcing elements. With reinforcing elements of synthetic geogrids

data.description: Providing and erecting a 'W' metal beam crash barrier comprising of 3 mm thick corrugated sheet metal beam rail, 70 cm above road/ground level, fixed on ISMC series channel vertical post, 150 x 75 x 5 mm spaced 2 m centre to centre, 1.8 m high, 1.1 m below ground/road level, all steel parts and fitments to be galvanised by hot dip process, all fittings to conform to IS:1367 and IS:1364, metal beam rail to be fixed on the vertical post with a clamp of channel section 150 x 75 x 5 mm, 330 mm long complete as per clause 810.

data.name: Metal Beam Crash Barrier - Type B, 'THRIE': Metal Beam Crash Barrier
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Providing and erecting a 'Thrie' metal beam crash barrier comprising of 3 mm thick corrugated sheet metal beam rail, 85 cm above road/ground level, vertical post, 150 x 75 x 5 mm spaced 2 m centre, 2 m high 1.15 m below ground level, all steel parts and fitments to be galvanised by hot dip process, all fittings to conform to IS:1367 and IS:1364, metal beam rail to be fixed on the vertical post with a space of channel section 150 x 75 x 5 mm, 546 mm long complete as per clause 810.

data.name: Flexible Crash Barrier, Wire Rope Safety Barrier
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Providing and erecting a wire rope safety barrier with vertical posts of medium weight RS Joist (ISMB series) 100 mm x 75 mm (11.50 kg/m), 1.50 m long 0.85 m above ground and 0.65 m below ground, split at the bottom for better grip, embedded in M15 grade cement concrete 450 x 450 x 450 mm, 1.50 m center to center and with 4 horizontal steel wire rope 40 mm dia anchored at terminal posts 15 m apart. Terminal post to be embedded in M15 grade cement concrete foundation 2400 x 450 x 900 mm (depth), strengthened by a strut of RS Joist 100 x 75 x 8 mm, 2 m long at 450 inclination and a tie rod 10 x 8 mm, 1.50 m long at the bottom, all embedded in foundation concrete as per approved design and drawing, rate excluding excavation and cement concrete.

data.name: Anti-Glare Devices in Median - Anti-glare screen with 25 mm steel pipe framework fixed with circular and rectangular vanes
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Providing and erecting an anti-glare screen with 25 mm dia vertical pipes fabricated and framed in the form of panels of one metre length and 1.75 metre height fixed with circular 250 mm dia at top and rectangular vane 600 x 300 mm at the middle, made out of steel sheet of 3 mm thickness, end vertical pipes of the panel all exposed surfaces, applying 2 coats of paint on all exposed surfaces, all as per approved design and drawings.

data.name: Anti-Glare Devices in Median - Anti-glare screen with rectangular vane of MS sheet
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Providing and erecting anti-glare screen with rectangular vanes of size 750 x 500 mm made from MS sheet, 3 mm thick and fixed on MS angle 50 x 50 x 6 mm at an angle of 450 to the direction of flow of traffic, 1.5 m center to center, top edge of the screen 1.75 m above ground level, vertical post firmly embedded in M-15 cement concrete foundation 0.60 m below ground level, applying 2 coats of paint on exposed faces, all complete as per approved design and drawings.

data.name: Street Lighting - For Fixing in Median
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Providing and erecting street light mounted on a steel circular hollow pole of standard specifications for street lighting, 9 m high spaced 40 m apart, 1.8 m overhang on both sides if fixed in the median and on one side if fixed on the footpath, fitted with sodium vapour lamp and fixed firmly in concrete foundation. For Fixing in Median.

data.name: Street Lighting - For Fixing in Footpath
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Providing and erecting street light mounted on a steel circular hollow pole of standard specifications for street lighting, 9 m high spaced 40 m apart, 1.8 m overhang on both sides if fixed in the median and on one side if fixed on the footpath, fitted with sodium vapour lamp and fixed firmly in concrete foundation. For Fixing in Footpath.

data.name: Lighting on Bridges
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Providing and fixing lighting on bridges, mounted on steel circular poles of standard specifications, 5 m high fixed on parapets with cement mortar, 20 m apart and fitted with sodium vapour lamp.

data.name: Cable Duct Across the Road - Single row for one utility service
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Providing and laying of a reinforced cement concrete pipe duct, 300 mm dia, across the road (new construction), extending from drain to drain in cuts and toe of slope to toe of slope in fills, constructing head walls at both ends, providing a minimum fill of granular material over top and sides of RCC pipe as per IRC:98-1997, bedded on a 0.3 m thick layer of granular material free of rock pieces, outer to outer distance of pipe at least half dia of pipe subject to minimum 450 mm in case of double and triple row ducts, joints to be made leak proof, invert level of duct to be above higher than ground level to prevent entry of water and dirt, all as per IRC : 98 - 1997 and approved drawings. Single row for one utility service.

data.name: Cable Duct Across the Road - Double row for two utility service
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Providing and laying of a reinforced cement concrete pipe duct, 300 mm dia, across the road (new construction), extending from drain to drain in cuts and toe of slope to toe of slope in fills, constructing head walls at both ends, providing a minimum fill of granular material over top and sides of RCC pipe as per IRC:98-1997, bedded on a 0.3 m thick layer of granular material free of rock pieces, outer to outer distance of pipe at least half dia of pipe subject to minimum 450 mm in case of double and triple row ducts, joints to be made leak proof, invert level of duct to be above higher than ground level to prevent entry of water and dirt, all as per IRC : 98 - 1997 and approved drawings. Double row for two utility service.

data.name: Cable Duct Across the Road - Triple row for three utility services
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Providing and laying of a reinforced cement concrete pipe duct, 300 mm dia, across the road (new construction), extending from drain to drain in cuts and toe of slope to toe of slope in fills, constructing head walls at both ends, providing a minimum fill of granular material over top and sides of RCC pipe as per IRC:98-1997, bedded on a 0.3 m thick layer of granular material free of rock pieces, outer to outer distance of pipe at least half dia of pipe subject to minimum 450 mm in case of double and triple row ducts, joints to be made leak proof, invert level of duct to be above higher than ground level to prevent entry of water and dirt, all as per IRC : 98 - 1997 and approved drawings. Triple row for three utility services.

data.name: Gantry Mounted Variable Message Sign Board - Gantry Support System
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Providing and erecting gantry mounted variable message sign board electronically operated capable of flashing the desired message over a designed support system of aluminium alloy or galvanised steel, erected as per approved design and drawings and with lateral clearance as per clause 802.3. Gantry Support System.

data.name: Traffic Impact Attenuators at Abutments and Piers - With Scrap Tyres
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Provision and installation of traffic impact attenuators at abutment/pier of flyovers bridges using scrap tyres of size 100 x 20 retrieved from trucks laid in 2 rows and 4 tiers, one above the other and tied with 20 mm wire rope as per approved design and drawings.

data.name: Traffic Impact Attenuators at Abutments and Piers - Using Plastic/Steel Barrel, Filled with Sand
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Provision and installation of traffic impact attenuator at abutment/pier of flyovers bridges using plastic/steel barrels 0.60 m dia and 1.0 m in height, filled with sand in three rows and tied with 20 mm steel wire rope as per approved design and drawings.

data.name: Traffic Impact Attenuators at Abutments and Piers - With Hi-DRO cell Sandwich (Patented)
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: In this patented HI-DRO cell system, water gets discharged from plastic tubes on impact over a pre-determined time, thus absorbing the energy. Providing and installing a patented HI-DRO cell system as a traffic impact attenuators, using plastic tubes 50 cm dia, 1.2 m in height, 25 mm opening at the top, placed in three rows, filled with water and tied with 20 mm steel wire rope.

data.name: Road Markers/Road Stud with Lense Reflector
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Providing and fixing of road stud 100x 100 mm, die-cast in aluminium, resistant to corrosive effect of salt and grit, fitted with lense reflectors, installed in concrete or asphalt surface by drilling hole 50 mm upto a depth of 60 mm and bedded in a suitable bituminous grout or epoxy mortar, all as per BS 873 part 4:1973.

data.name: Traffic Cone
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Provision of red fluorescent with white reflective sleeve traffic cone made of low density polyethylene (LDPE) material with a square base of 390 x 390 x 35 mm and a height of 770 mm, 4 kg in weight, placed at 1.5 m interval, all as per BS 673.

data.name: Portable Barricade in Construction Zone
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Portable Barricade in Construction Zone - Installation of a portable barricade in construction zone complete as per Technical Specifications.

data.name: Permanent Type Barricade in Construction Zone - With steel components
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Construction of a permanent type barricade made of steel components, 1.5 m high from road level, fitted with 3 horizontal rails 200 mm wide and 4 m long on 50 x 50 x 5 mm angle iron vertical support, painted with yellow and white stripes, 150 mm in width at an angle of 450, complete as per IRC:SP:55-2001. With steel components.

data.name: Permanent Type Barricade in Construction Zone - With wooden components
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Construction of a permanent type barricade made of wooden components, 1.5 m high from road level, fitted with 3 horizontal planks 200 mm wide and 3.66 m long on 100 x 100mm vertical post, painted with yellow and white strips, 150 mm in width at an angle of 450, complete as per IRC:SP:55-2001. With wooden components.

data.name: Permanent Type Barricade in Construction Zone - With bricks
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Construction of a permanent type barricade made with brick work in mud mortar, 1.5 m high, 4 m long, 600 mm thick, plastered with cement mortar 1:6, painted with yellow and white strips. With bricks.

data.name: Drum Delineator in Construction Zone
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Drum Delineator in Construction Zone - Installation of drum delineator in construction zone complete as per Technical Specifications.

data.name: Flagman
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Positioning of a smart flagman with a yellow vest and a yellow cap and a red flag 600 x 600 mm securely fastened to a staff 1 m in length for guiding the traffic.

data.name: PCC 1:3:6 in Foundation
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Plain cement concrete 1:3:6 mix with crushed stone aggregate 40 mm nominal size mechanically mixed, placed in foundation and compacted by vibration including curing for 14 days.

data.name: Laying RCC Pipe NP4/PSC Pipe on First Class Bedding in Single Row - 1000 mm dia
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Laying Reinforced cement concrete pipe NP4/prestressed concrete pipe for culverts on first class bedding of granular material in single row including fixing collar with cement mortar 1:2 but excluding excavation, protection works, backfilling, concrete and masonry works in head walls and parapets. 1000 mm dia.

data.name: Laying RCC Pipe NP4/PSC Pipe on First Class Bedding in Single Row - 1200 mm dia
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Laying Reinforced cement concrete pipe NP4/prestressed concrete pipe for culverts on first class bedding of granular material in single row including fixing collar with cement mortar 1:2 but excluding excavation, protection works, backfilling, concrete and masonry works in head walls and parapets. 1200 mm dia.

data.name: Laying RCC Pipe NP4/PSC Pipe on First Class Bedding in Double Row - 1000 mm dia
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Laying Reinforced cement concrete pipe NP4/prestressed concrete pipe for culverts on first class bedding of granular material in double row including fixing collar with cement mortar 1:2 but excluding excavation, protection works, backfilling, concrete and masonry works in head walls and parapets. 1000 mm dia.

data.name: Laying RCC Pipe NP4/PSC Pipe on First Class Bedding in Double Row - 1200 mm dia
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Laying Reinforced cement concrete pipe NP4/prestressed concrete pipe for culverts on first class bedding of granular material in double row including fixing collar with cement mortar 1:2 but excluding excavation, protection works, backfilling, concrete and masonry works in head walls and parapets. 1200 mm dia.

data.name: Maintenance of Earth Shoulder (stripping excess soil)
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Stripping excess soil from the shoulder surface to achieve the approved level and compacting with plate compactor.

data.name: Filling Pot-holes with Open-Graded Premix Surfacing (20 mm)
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Filling Pot-holes and Patch Repairs with Open-Graded Premix Surfacing (20 mm) - Removal of all failed material, trimming of completed excavation to provide firm vertical faces, cleaning of surface, painting of tack coat on the sides and base of excavation as per clause 503, back filling the pot holes with hot bituminous material as per clause 504, compacting, trimming and finishing the surface to form a smooth continuous surface, all as per clause 3004.2.

data.name: Filling Pot-holes with Bituminous Concrete 40 mm (Grading I)
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Filling Pot-holes and Patch Repairs with Bituminous Concrete (40 mm) for Grading I Material - Removal of failed material, trimming, tack coat, backfilling with bituminous concrete, and compaction as per Technical Specifications.

data.name: Filling Pot-holes and Patch Repairs with Bituminous concrete, 40mm - for grading II Material
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Removal of all failed material, trimming of completed excavation to provide firm vertical faces, cleaning of surface, painting of tack coat on the sides and base of excavation as per clause 503, back filling the pot holes with hot bituminous material as per clause 504, compacting, trimming and finishing the surface to form a smooth continuous surface, all as per clause 3004.2. For grading II Material. - Filling Pot-holes and Patch Repairs with Bituminous concrete, 40mm - for grading II Material

data.name: Crack Filling
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Filling of crack using slow-curing bitumen emulsion and applying crusher dust in case crack is wider than 3mm.

data.name: Dusting Road Surface with Crusher Dust
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Dusting Road Surface with Crusher Dust - Applying crusher dust to areas of road where bleeding of excess bitumen has occurred complete as per Technical Specifications.

data.name: Repair of Joint Grooves with Epoxy Mortar
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Repair of spalled joint grooves of contraction joints, longitudinal joints and expansion joints in concrete pavements using epoxy mortar or epoxy concrete.

data.name: Restoration of Rain Cuts on Road Embankment/Slopes
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Restoration of rain-cut damage on road embankments/slopes. The work involves clearing the affected area, benching, filling with approved soil in 150 mm layers, and compacting to match the original profile.

data.name: Hill Side Drain Clearance
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Removal of earth from the choked hill side drain and disposing it on the valley side manually. Assuming muck causing choking of drain to be 0.2 cum per metre, quantity of earth to be removed for 10 metres = 2 cum.

data.name: Land Slide Clearance in soil
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Clearance of land slides in soil and ordinary rock by a bull-dozer D 80 A-12, 180 HP and disposal of the same on the valley side.

data.name: Landslide Clearance in Hard Rock Requiring Blasting
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Clearing of land slide in hard rock requiring blasting for 50 per cent of the boulders and disposal of the same on the valley side.

data.name: Snow Clearance on Roads with Dozer
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Snow clearance from road surface by a bull-dozer 165 Hp and disposing it on the valley side.

data.name: Spreading of Sludge Farm Yard Manure or/and Good Earth
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Spreading of sludge farm yard manure or/and good earth in required thickness (cost of sludge, farm yard manure or/and good earth to be paid for separately).

data.name: Grassing with 'Doobs' Grass - In rows 15 cm apart in either direction
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Grassing with 'Doobs' grass including watering and maintenance of the lawn for 30 days or more till the grass forms a thick lawn free from weeds and fit for mowing including supplying good earth if needed. In rows 15 cm apart in either direction.

data.name: Grassing with 'Doobs' Grass - In rows 7.5 cm apart in either direction
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Grassing with 'Doobs' grass including watering and maintenance of the lawn for 30 days or more till the grass forms a thick lawn free from weeds and fit for mowing including supplying good earth if needed. In rows 7.5 cm apart in either direction.

data.name: Making Lawns including Ploughing and Dragging with 'Swagha' Breaking of Clod
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Making lawns including ploughing and breaking of clod, removal of rubbish, dressing and supplying doobs grass roots and planting at 15 cm apart, including supplying and spreading of farm yard manure at rate of 0.18 cum per 100 sqm.

data.name: Maintenance of Lawns or Turfing of Slopes
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Maintenance of lawns or Turfing of slopes (rough grassing) for a period of one year including watering etc.

data.name: Turfing Lawns with Fine Grasing including Ploughing, Dressing
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Turfing lawns with fine grassing including ploughing, dressing including breaking of clods, removal of rubbish, dressing and supplying doobs grass roots and grassing at 10 cm apart.

data.name: Maintenance of Lawns with Fine Grassing for the First Year
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Maintenance of lawns with fine grassing for the first year including watering etc.

data.name: Planting and Maintaining of Permanent Hedges - Planting permanent hedges including digging of trenches
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Planting permanent hedges including digging of trenches, 60 cm wide and 45 cm deep, refilling the excavated earth mixed with farmyard manure, supplied at the rate of 4.65 cum per 100 metres and supplying and planting hedge plants at 30 cm apart.

data.name: Permanent Hedge Maintenance (1 Year)
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Planting and Maintaining of Permanent Hedges - Maintenance of hedge for one year complete as per Technical Specifications.

data.name: Planting and Maintaining of Flowering Plants and Shrub - Planting flowering plants and shrub in central verge
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Planting flowering plants and shrub in central verge. 200 plants and 800 shrubs in two rows in one km length of road where width of verge is 3m and above.

data.name: Flowering Plants and Shrub Maintenance (Central Verge, 1 Year)
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Planting and Maintaining of Flowering Plants and Shrub - Maintenance of flowering plants and shrub in central verge for one year complete as per Technical Specifications.

data.name: Spreading of Sludge Farm Yard Manure or/and Good Earth
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Spreading of sludge farm yard manure or/and good earth in required thickness (cost of sludge, farm yard manure or/and good earth to be paid for separately).

data.name: Half Brick Circular Tree Guard, in 2nd Class Brick, internal diameter 1.25 metres, and height 1.2 metres, above ground and 0.20 metre below ground
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Half brick circular tree guard, in 2nd class brick, internal diameter 1.25 metres, and height 1.2 metres, above ground and 0.20 metre below ground, bottom two courses laid dry, and top three courses in cement mortar 1:6 (1 cement 6 sand) and the intermediate courses being in dry honey comb masonry, as per design complete.

data.name: Edging with 2nd Class Bricks, Laid Dry Lengthwise
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Edging with 2nd class bricks, laid dry lengthwise, including excavation, refilling, consolidation, with a hand packing and spreading nearly surplus earth within a lead of 50 metres.

data.name: Making Tree Guard 53 cm dia and 1.3 m High as per Design from Empty Bitumen Drums
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Making tree guard 53 cm dia and 1.3 m high as per design from empty bitumen drums, slit suitably to permit sun and air, (supplied by the department at stock issue rate) including providing and fixing 2 nos MS sheet rings 50 x 0.5 mm with rivets, complete in all respects.

data.name: Making Tree Guard 53 cm dia and 2 Metre High as per Design from Empty Bitumen Drums
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Making tree guard 53 cm dia and 2 metres high as per design from empty bitumen drums, slit suitably to permit sun and air, (supplied by the department at stock issue rate) including providing and fixing four legs 40 cm long of 30 x 3 mm MS riveted to tree guard and providing and fixing four MS sheet rings 50 x 0.5 mm with rivets complete in all respects.

data.name: Wrought Iron and Mild Steel Welded Work
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Wrought iron and mild steel welded work (using angles, square bars, tees and channel grils, grating frames, gates and tree guards of any size and design etc. including cost of screens and welding rods or bolts and nuts complete fixed in position but be paid separately).

data.name: Tree Guard with MS Iron
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Providing and fixing MS iron tree guard 60 cm dia and 2 metre high above ground level formed of 4 Nos (25 x 6 mm) and 8 Nos (25 x 3 mm) vertical MS riveted to 3 Nos (25 x 3 mm) iron rings in two halves, bolted together with 3 mm dia and 30 mm long bolts including painting two coats with paint of approved brand over a coat of priming, complete in all respects.

data.name: Tree Guard with MS Angle iron and Steel Wire
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Providing and fixing tree guard 0.60 metre square, 2.00 metre high fabricated with MS angle iron 30 x 30 x 3 mm, MS iron 25 x 3 mm and steel wire 3 mm dia welded and fabricated as per design in two halves bolted together

data.name: Compensatory Afforestation
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Planting trees as compensatory afforestation at the rate of 290 trees per hectare at a spacing of 6 m by grubbing and leveling the ground upto a depth of 150 mm, digging holes 0.9 m dia, 1 m deep, mixing farm yard/sludge manure with soil, planting of sapling 2 m high with 25 cm dia stem, backfilling the hole and watering.

data.name: Boulder Laid Dry Without Wire Crates
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Boulder Laid Dry Without Wire Crates - Providing and laying boulders apron on river bed for protection against scour with stone boulders weighing not less than 40 kg each complete as per drawing and Technical Specifications.

data.name: Boulder Apron Laid in Wire Crates
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Providing and laying of boulder apron laid in wire crates made with 4mm dia GI wire conforming to IS: 280 & IS:4826 in 100mm x 100mm mesh (weaved diagonally) including for laps and joints laid with stone boulders weighing not less than 40 kg each.

data.name: Cement Concrete Blocks (size 0.5 x 0.5 x 0.5 m)
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Providing and laying of apron with cement concrete blocks of size 0.5x0.5x0.5 m cast-in-situ and made with nominal mix of M-15 grade cement concrete with a minimum cement content of 250 kg/cum as per IRC: 21-2000.

data.name: Pitching on slopes laid over prepared filter media including boulder apron - Stone/Boulder
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Providing and laying Pitching on slopes laid over prepared filter media including boulder apron laid dry in front of toe of embankment complete as per drawing and Technical specifications. Stone/Boulder.

data.name: Pitching on slopes laid over prepared filter media including boulder apron - Cement Concrete Blocks of size 0.3x0.3x0.3 m cast in Grade M15
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Providing and laying Pitching on slopes laid over prepared filter media including boulder apron laid dry in front of toe of embankment complete as per drawing and Technical specifications. Cement Concrete Blocks of size 0.3x0.3x0.3 m cast in cement concrete of Grade M15.

data.name: Filter material underneath pitching in slopes
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Providing and laying Filter material underneath pitching in slopes complete as per drawing and Technical specification.

data.name: Geotextile Filter

data.description: Laying of a geotextile filter between pitching and embankment slopes on which pitching is laid to prevent escape of the embankment material through the voids of the stone pitching/cement concrete blocks and also to allow free movement of water without creating any uplift head on the pitching.

data.name: Flooring complete as per drawing laid over concrete bedding - Rubble stone laid in cement mortar 1:3
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Providing and laying Flooring complete as per drawing and Technical specifications laid over concrete bedding. Rubble stone laid in cement mortar 1:3. Cement mortar 1:3 (rate as in item 12.6 sub-analysis) excluding OH & CP. Add for cement concrete bedding (M15 nominal mix) vide item 12.8 (A) excluding OH & CP; quantity to be adopted as per design (assume rubble stone flooring thickness 300mm and cement concrete bedding thickness 100mm).

data.name: Flooring complete as per drawing laid over concrete bedding - Cement concrete blocks Grade M15
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Providing and laying Flooring complete as per drawing and Technical specifications laid over concrete bedding. Cement concrete blocks Grade M15. Concrete Grade M15 block, rate as per item No. 12.8 (A) including OH & CP. Add for cement concrete bedding (M15 nominal mix) vide Item 12.8 (A) including OH & CP; quantity to be adopted as per design (assume cement concrete blocks thickness 300mm and cement concrete bedding thickness 100mm).

data.name: Dry Rubble Flooring
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Construction of dry rubble flooring at cross drainage works for relatively less important works.

data.name: Curtain wall complete as per drawing - Stone masonry in cement mortar (1:3)
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Curtain wall complete as per drawing and Technical specification. Stone masonry in cement mortar (1:3). Coursed rubble masonry (1st sort), rate same as per item No. 12.7 (A) including OH & CP.

data.name: Curtain wall complete as per drawing - Cement concrete Grade M15
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Curtain wall complete as per drawing and Technical specification. Cement concrete Grade M15. Concrete Grade M15, rate as per item No. 12.8 (A) including OH & CP.

data.name: Flexible Apron
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Flexible Apron: Construction of flexible apron 1 m thick comprising of loose stone boulders weighing not less than 40 kg beyond curtain wall.

data.name: Gabian Structure for Retaining Earth
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Providing and construction of a gabian structure for retaining earth with segments of wire crates of size 7 m x 3 m x 0.6 m each divided into 1.5 m compartments by cross netting, made from 4 mm galvanised steel wire @ 32 kg per 10 sqm having minimum tensile strength of 300 Mpa conforming to IS:280 and galvanizing coating conforming to IS:4826, woven into mesh with double twist, mesh size not exceeding 100 x 100 mm, filled with boulders with least dimension of 200 mm, all loose ends to be tied with 4 mm galvanised steel wire.

data.name: Gabian Structure for Erosion Control, River Training Works and Protection works
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Providing and constructing gabian structures for erosion control, river training works and protection works with wire crates of size 2 m x 1 m x 0.3 m each divided into 1m compartments by cross netting, made from 4 mm galvanised steel wire @ 32 kg per 10 sqm having minimum tensile strength of 300 Mpa conforming to IS:280 and galvanizing coating conforming to IS:4826, woven into mesh with double twist, mesh size not exceeding 100 x 100 mm, filled with boulders with least dimension of 200 mm, all loose ends to be tied with 4 mm galvanised steel wire.

data.name: Removal of defective concrete and application of shotcrete
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Removal of defective concrete, cleaning the surface thoroughly, applying the shotcrete mortar mechanically with compressed air under pressure, comprising of cement, sand, coarse aggregates, water and quick setting compound in the proportion as per clause 2807.1, sand and coarse aggregate conforming to IS: 383 and table 1 of IS: 9012 respectively, water cement ratio ranging from 0.35 to 0.50, density of gunite not less than 2000 kg/cum, strength not less than 35 Mpa and workmanship conforming to clause 2807.6. Unit = sqm, taking output = 10 sqm, 40 mm average thickness.

data.name: Repair of Crash Barrier (Repair of concrete crash barrier with cement concert of M-30 grade by cutting and trimming the damaged portion to a regular shape, cleaning the area to be repaired thoroughly, applying cement concert after erection of proper form work.)
data.rate_src: Telangana SOR 2025-26
data.description: Repair of Crash Barrier Repair of concrete crash barrier with cement concert of M-30 grade by cutting and trimming the damaged portion to a regular shape, cleaning the area to be repaired thoroughly, applying cement concert after erection of proper form work. It is assumed that damage is to the extent of 10 per cent  of the volume of concrete .This will require 0.30 cum of concrete. For dismantling and trimming the surface to a regular shape and removal of damaged material. This may be priced based on the rate given the chapter of superstructure. Unit: Running meter.. Priced on the basis of Taking output  10 M..
